newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EU, U.S. hit SKorea over "frugality campaign".
newsitem.headline: EU, U.S. hit SKorea over "frugality campaign".

text.p: The European Union and the United States on Tuesday attacked South Korea over its "frugality campaign", suggesting the government was breaking global trading rules in a bid to cut imports.

At a meeting of the World Trade Organisation's (WTO) Council for Trade in Goods, officials of the two powers called on Seoul to take a clear public stand on the issue which they said was having a serious effect on exports to the key Asian market.

"We believe that (South) Korea has a responsibility to reassure its trading partners that the impression that it is hostile to imports and hesitant about two-way trade is mistaken," the EU's Ian Wilkinson told the Council.

"Recent statements by (South) Korean government officials suggesting that it is a citizen's 'patriotic' duty not to consume imports have reinforced the perception of an anti-import bias in Korea," declared U.S. WTO envoy Andrew Stoler.
